proposal: Alternative (c): load limitation on gas between 40 and 45 barg, no compressor, no price change.
question: As requested: (a) booster compressor option, 2 x 100 % electric reciprocating units, 115,000 Sm3/h from 40 to 47 barg, about 1.3 MW each: EUR 6,800,000, 14 months delivery, no key-date impact if ordered by 2027-03-31. (b) Estimated operation below 45 barg: about 40 h/year based on the network data. (c) Zero-cost alternative: between 40 and 45 barg the GT reduces load to the pressure-limited load (about 60 % GT load at 40 barg) and stays on gas; transfer to LDO only below 40 barg. Which does the Owner choose?
response: The Owner chooses alternative (c): no booster compressor. Between 40 and 45 barg the plant operates on gas at the pressure-limited load; automatic transfer to LDO only below 40 barg. ER-03.03 is revised. TQ-003 is closed by this answer.
subject: Low gas pressure: booster compressor option vs load limitation
